name: restockcheck-mcp
description: Read-only MCP server for public Apple Store pickup availability, restock summaries, and CC BY 4.0 service reliability telemetry.

tools.name: list_monitored_apple_stores
tools.description: Lists live-tracked hub Apple Stores (filterable by country us/gb/jp/cn) with polling tier and live pickup availability summary.

tools.name: get_store_pickup_status
tools.description: Fetches live pickup status, per-configuration availability, and recent restock history for a specific monitored Apple Store.

tools.name: get_restock_summary
tools.description: Returns live public restock summary metrics including in-stock counts by country, 24h/7d restock totals, and observation freshness.

tools.name: get_service_reliability_report
tools.description: Returns CC BY 4.0 check interval quantiles (P50/P90/P95), sample sizes, alert dispatch latency, and optional per-store health status.
